# Viola isolation test recording

`viola-c3.wav.gz` contains the first three seconds of Charletta Taylor
playing the bowed open C string. Lawrence Fritts and the University of Iowa
Electronic Music Studios publish these recordings for use in any project
without restriction. [Sample collection](https://theremin.music.uiowa.edu/MIS.html)
· [Viola recordings](https://theremin.music.uiowa.edu/MISviola.html)

The source is `Viola.arco.sulC.mf.C3B3.aiff`. The fixture uses its first 66,150
samples after conversion to 22,050 Hz mono PCM16. The tests combine it with
the recorded cough and footstep in the violin isolation fixtures.
[Original AIFF](https://theremin.music.uiowa.edu/sound%20files/MIS/Strings/viola/Viola.arco.sulC.mf.C3B3.aiff)
